up: Retrieve activity records for human Metabotropic glutamate receptor 5 (CHEMBL3227). Output columns: molecule_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_name, organism. Filter conditions: standard_type = 'IC50', standard_units = 'nM', target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3227', target_dictionary.organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Additionally, filter to only include rows where canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL and (docs.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR docs.doi IS NOT NULL). For pubmed_id_or_doi, use COALESCE(CAST(docs.pubmed_id AS TEXT), docs.doi). Join activities with assays, target_dictionary, compound_structures, compound_records, docs, and molecule_dictionary as needed.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  a.description AS assay_description,
  ac.standard_type,
  ac.standard_relation,
  ac.standard_value,
  ac.standard_units,
  ac.activity_comment,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism
FROM activities ac
JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid
JOIN compound_records cr ON ac.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN docs d ON ac.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3227'
  AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
  AND ac.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND ac.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
  AND (d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR d.doi IS NOT NULL)
